claims.statement: A Classroom classroom is described as the teacher/student course interaction space, supporting teacher rosters and assignment creation, assignment, review and grading. These are capabilities, not verified pedagogical quality, actual roster entries or authorization to access student records.

Feedback pull requests are optional per assignment; enabling them creates a special Feedback PR in each student or group assignment repository. PR existence is not substantive feedback, completed review, student acknowledgment or grading evidence; the linked procedure remains separate.

Classroom can integrate an IDE, while students may alternatively check out and run assignment code locally with suitable software. Integration is not a universal hosted-IDE requirement, execution approval or proof of a functional environment.

Assignment IDE configuration is optional and may support coding, running and collaboration without local Git/full-toolchain installation. Local checkout and execution remain available with necessary software; the source does not prove privacy, safe code execution, tool availability or zero cost.

On accepting a group assignment, a student can create a team or join an existing one. Assignment teams are stored as a set that can be named during assignment creation and reused later. Acceptance/team membership does not itself prove repository authorization or peer-assessment completion; reuse is an option, not a mandatory persistent roster.

Creating a classroom is a prerequisite to creating an assignment. This is a conditional workflow dependency, not a universal instruction to create a classroom; the linked management page is not inherited reviewed evidence.
